title: Construction and verification of a prediction model for sleep disorders in older patients with coronary heart disease based on machine learning algorithms.
summary: Using LASSO feature selection and several machine-learning classifiers, the study predicted sleep disorders in older patients with coronary heart disease, with internal-split and temporal-cohort evaluation. The retrospective result is cohort-specific.
ai_technology: LASSO selects predictors and several classifiers predict sleep disorders in older patients with coronary heart disease.
organization: Department of Medical Affairs, the Second Affiliated Hospital of Hunan University of Chinese Medicine, Changsha; School of Nursing, Hunan University of Chinese Medicine, Changsha; Department of Nursing, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Hunan University of Chinese Medicine, Changsha

evidence.tested: Internal split and temporal-cohort validation in a retrospective study; no external prospective clinical benefit was established.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO selects predictors and several classifiers predict sleep disorders in older patients with coronary heart disease.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
